name: Abnormal telemetry: CFE_SB sb cmderr
description: Software-bus command-error surge — malformed or unauthorized command injection.
author: Elastic
false_positives: Authorized high-activity operations (a planned payload burst, a maintenance window, an orbital eclipse for power) can move this metric. Tune per mission via detection exceptions at deployment.
note:
## SPARTA Investigation Guide

### Detection logic
A machine-learning anomaly job (`high_mean` on `parameters.CMDERRCNT`) over the `CFE_SB_HKMSG` telemetry in `logs-pisat-telemetry`. It learns the packet's normal range and flags a deviation, attributed to the packet/subsystem via influencers. Software-bus command-error surge — malformed or unauthorized command injection.

### Framework reference
- **Tactic:** Execution
- **Technique EX-0013:** [Flooding](https://sparta.aerospace.org/technique/EX-0013/)

### How to validate this alert
Confirm the metric's deviation against the recent baseline, correlate its timing with the command feed (hazardous / flooding rules) and the SPACECOP IDS alert, and ask the AI agent to attribute any correlated command to a registered operator. See spartastixkb for countermeasures.
